qwen3.8-flash: Fast, lower-cost general-purpose model with lower capability than Max. Prefer for routine transformations, extraction, translation, straightforward code, and simple tool steps when sufficient.
qwen3.8-max: Higher-capability, higher-cost general-purpose model that may be slower than Flash. Prefer for difficult reasoning, complex coding, multi-constraint planning, nuanced instruction following, and tasks requiring deep correctness analysis when the added capability justifies the cost and potential latency.
